### Remote work

The topic of remote work within the scope of entrepreneurship y business represents an extremely broad and fascinating area of study that has attracted the attention of researchers, professionals, and enthusiasts around the world for decades. From its most remote origins to the most contemporary applications, this field has experienced notable evolution that reflects both scientific and technological advances as well as cultural and social changes that have marked human history.
